critical_code_review_comments: ai_codegen.py:315-316 correctly rejects spec belonging to different project with 400 BEFORE requirements lookup. Not exercised by pytest (no cross-project spec available in seed) but logic is correct.
ai_codegen.py:190-213 _validate_files correctly guards against path traversal (`..`, leading `/` or `~`) and de-duplicates paths. Good security posture.
ai_codegen.py:281 snapshot failure is caught and logged but does not fail the codegen — verified trigger=ai.code snapshot is created when bg task completes (tree integration test passes).
ai_codegen.py:420-424 include_content=false correctly uses projection {'files': 0} to skip bulky payload for lighter polling — verified.

ai_codegen.py:437-438 403 path for non-author non-admin delete is correctly implemented; could not exercise via pytest because existing codegen is owned by dev user (so delete would 200, not 403). Recommend adding a unit-level test with a seeded codegen owned by a different email for full coverage.

CodeGenPage.jsx:267-295 polling logic has a subtle concern: pollerRef.current holds the timeout id, but if activeId changes rapidly (e.g., user clicks another history item while processing), the cleanup only cancels via `cancelled` flag; the ref may leak a timeout set for the old id. Low impact (auto-cleared on next effect cycle).
CodeGenPage.jsx:254 auto-selects first spec_id only when form.spec_id is empty — good, avoids clobbering user choice.
Download via fetch+blob+anchor pattern (lines 336-350) works correctly with Bearer auth (can't use <a href> directly since header is required).
Download uses localStorage.getItem('session_token') directly (line 338) instead of authHeaders() helper — minor DRY nit.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing codegen ce7b7e93-9d98-4a9d-934e-c0df5f129b8c and LTI project/spec as instructed. No new LLM call fired.
